projection_barrier: Each live88-byte CallFrame load has an owning retain and whole-record phi, in addition to its scalar ip projection. Not every use is a field projection.
lending_barrier: The records enter control-flow/loop phis and consuming frame updates. They must survive Runtime calls that may replace frames; disjoint-call lending alone does not remove the whole-record owning interval.
construction_barrier: The48-byte FunctionObj is produced before the destination frame slot bounds/uniqueness/old-child release. Passing its sret directly into an existing slot would overwrite live old fields before release and change snapshot/trap ordering.
preserved: No workload edits, count changes, removed checks, or counters relabeling.
next_optimizer_lever: Fieldwise SSA for loop-carried owned record snapshots, including managed fields and retained lifetime tokens, followed by selective materialization at mut-frame ABI uses. Prove effects/lifetime and trapping order through every incoming phi edge before lending list storage.
construction_alternative: An allocation/destination continuation ABI could defer FunctionObj materialization until after the frame slot is bounds-checked, detached if shared, and old references released; a raw sret into the current slot is insufficient.
